items.title: Louie Bellson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: That was through Buddy Baker and Marty Berman, the baritone saxophone player with Tommy’s band. They both recommended me to join Harry.

ctx.x: I don’t know if we captured it or not: how did you get into Harry James’s band?
